# so any rule that needs them is inactive.

facts = {
    "camel_movie_year": 2015,
    "camel_job_agri": True,          # grain elevator operator -> agriculture

    "llama_has_instrument": False,   # knapsack is not a musical instrument
    "llama_works_cs": False,         # not stated
    "pelikan_movie_after_fb": False, # not stated
    "camel_has_seat": False,         # not stated
}
MARADONA_DEATH = 2020
prefs = {(11,10),(11,6),(2,8),(4,8),(5,3),(7,1),(9,10),(9,6)}  # (a,b): a beats b

def resolve(cands):
    # cands: list of (rule, active, value); return value of an undefeated active rule
    act = [(r, v) for r, a, v in cands if a]
    surv = [(r, v) for r, v in act if not any((o, r) in prefs for o, _ in act)]
    vals = {v for _, v in surv}
    return vals.pop() if len(vals) == 1 else None

# pelikan captures king of gadwall?
